exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.cue: 1-2 s pause on the chest, explode up. Shoulder blades squeezed, feet planted, elbows ~45°.
exercises.substitutions: DB bench press / Machine chest press / Smith bench

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.cue: 1.5x shoulder-width grip, pull elbows down and in, slow 2-3 s negative.
exercises.substitutions: Wide-grip pull-up / Machine pulldown

exercises.name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
exercises.cue: Deep stretch at the bottom, squeeze shoulder blades together at the top.
exercises.substitutions: Chest-supported machine row / Incline DB row

exercises.name: 45° Incline DB Press
exercises.cue: Mind-muscle connection with the upper chest, control the bottom.
exercises.substitutions: Incline Smith press / Incline machine press

exercises.name: Incline Lying DB Lateral Raise
exercises.cue: Lie on your side on a ~30° bench, raise the DB 'out' not 'up'.
exercises.substitutions: Cuffed cable lateral raise / DB lateral raise

exercises.name: Bayesian Cable Curl
exercises.cue: Cable at hand height, elbow behind the torso, feel the stretch each rep.
exercises.substitutions: Incline DB curl / EZ-bar curl

exercises.name: Triceps Pressdown (Rope)
exercises.cue: Squeeze triceps to move the weight, elbows pinned.
exercises.substitutions: DB kickback / Bar pressdown

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.cue: Sit back and down, ~15° toe flare, drive knees out. Brace hard before every rep.
exercises.substitutions: Hack squat / Smith squat

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.cue: Lean forward over the machine for a maximum hamstring stretch.
exercises.substitutions: Lying leg curl / Nordic curl

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.cue: Feet lower for quads, go as deep as you can without the lower back rounding.
exercises.substitutions: Hack squat / Goblet squat

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.cue: Seat back, hold the handles, squeeze the quads hard at the top.
exercises.substitutions: Sissy squat / Reverse nordic

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.cue: 1-2 s pause at the bottom, roll up onto your big toe.
exercises.substitutions: Leg press calf press / Seated calf raise

exercises.name: Machine Hip Abduction
exercises.cue: Lean forward, drive the knees out.
exercises.substitutions: Cable hip abduction / Lateral band walk

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.cue: Roll the hips up as you squeeze the lower abs, no swinging.
exercises.substitutions: Roman chair leg raise / Reverse crunch

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.cue: Squeeze glutes to stay upright, move your head out of the way, press up and slightly back.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up (weighted if easy)
exercises.cue: Pull your chest to the bar, full stretch at the bottom.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Deficit Row
exercises.cue: Big stretch at the bottom, touch the bar to your stomach.
exercises.substitutions: Pendlay row / Helms row

exercises.name: Flat Machine Chest Press
exercises.cue: 1 s pause at the stretch while keeping tension.
exercises.substitutions: Flat DB press / Low-incline DB press

exercises.name: Super-Stretch Reverse Pec Deck
exercises.cue: Side-on to the machine, pull your arm across and 'out', not back.
exercises.substitutions: Reverse cable flye / Bent-over reverse DB flye

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.cue: Swing the weight 'out', not 'up'.
exercises.substitutions: DB lateral raise / Machine lateral raise

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
exercises.cue: Arc the bar behind your head, constant tension on the triceps.
exercises.substitutions: Overhead cable extension / DB skull crusher

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.cue: 3 s negative, arc the DB 'out' not 'up'.

exercises.name: Deadlift

exercises.substitutions: Trap-bar deadlift / Sumo deadlift

exercises.name: DB Bulgarian Split Squat

exercises.substitutions: Walking lunge / Single-leg leg press

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl

exercises.substitutions: Seated leg curl / Swiss-ball leg curl

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust

exercises.substitutions: Glute bridge / 45° hyperextension

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise

exercises.substitutions: Standing calf raise / Leg press calf press

exercises.name: Machine Hip Adduction
exercises.cue: Mind-muscle connection with the inner thighs.
exercises.substitutions: Cable adduction / Copenhagen adduction

exercises.name: Cable Crunch

rules.failure_note: '~9-10*' = failure allowed on the LAST set of isolation exercises only (weeks 5-8)
rules.recovery_rule: If a lift's performance drops two sessions in a row, suggest removing 1 set from that day's accessories (never from the primary).
rules.late_cut_rule: Weeks 15-18: if a top set misses its rep target, suggest skipping that day's back-off sets.
rules.progression: Accessories: when all sets hit the top of the rep range at or below the target RPE, suggest +2.5 kg next time; otherwise aim for +1 rep.

adjust_rules: weekly avg loss < 0.5% for 2 consecutive cut weeks -> suggest -150 kcal or +2000 steps/day
